description: Search events that are on sale, soonest first. Optional filters: a case-insensitive literal text match on the event name, and an inclusive UTC date range on the start.

from_date.description: Earliest start date, ISO yyyy-MM-dd, inclusive (UTC)

limit.description: Most events to return, 1 to 50; default 10

query.description: Text to find in the event name, ignoring case

to_date.description: Latest start date, ISO yyyy-MM-dd, inclusive (UTC)

name: search_events
